title: File:Doi Pui mountains, Chiang Mai, Thailand.jpg
claims: A hillside village on a Doi Pui ridge: tightly packed houses and a winding concrete road on a green slope, with terraced fields, scattered trees and a forested ridge behind under a partly cloudy sky. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Doi Pui mountains, Chiang Mai, Thailand.jpg. The route page uses it as Doi Pui village context near A15 Wat Doi Pui, the highest aid station in the official ELEPHANT 100 table; it does not show the temple, the aid station or the race route.

The Commons author field reads Vyacheslav Argenberg; the file is marked CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the relevant date is 2010-11-21 14:41:00; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 4,032 × 2,688 px; 8,931,309 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 640 px; 249,071 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Vyacheslav Argenberg, CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
